issues.description: App entry renders placeholder <Root> instead of actual <App /> — entire application will not render
EV approximation treats GTO frequency as EV multiplier (freq.call * 2) — produces meaningless EV values for decision analysis
Multi-way pot tie handling incorrect — totalWins += 0.5 regardless of opponent count, overestimates equity
Hardcoded fold probability (0.6/0.7) for all bet/raise sizes regardless of context — unreliable EV estimates
Cursor pagination loads ALL records via toArray() then filters in JS — O(n) memory with 5000+ records target
In-memory engine registry loses all hand state on page reload — no persistence or recovery mechanism
Chip movements record 0 for losing players instead of actual loss — incomplete settlement tracking
Worker error rejects all pending requests instead of falling back to heuristic — violates degraded fallback spec
Missing PotManager.markAllIn() call when blind posting causes all-in — may miscalculate side pots
Unsafe type cast (hand as any).bettingState — should expose via public getter
Bot detection uses fragile name.startsWith('BOT') but bots are named TAG-42, LAG-73 etc.
totalEvLoss never incremented — avgEvLossPerHand always returns 0
Worker URL hardcodes .ts extension — may break in production builds
Missing ESLint/Prettier config files specified in T-001
Keyboard shortcuts (←/→) for replay navigation not implemented per T-024
Phase naming inconsistency with useGameLoop — may hide action panel during dealing/settling
Duplicate test configuration in both vite.config.ts and vitest.config.ts
Fold equity formula caps at 70% for any bet size — consider street-aware adjustments
